name: context-meter
description: Speaks up once when the context passes the handoff mark, when usage limits near 90%, at a push or merge with a big context, and before the prompt cache lapses. /ctx shows size, limits and cost; /handoff writes a phase handoff from a cache-read fork.

handoffAt.title: Handoff mark (tokens)
handoffAt.description: Past this context size, suggest a handoff and /clear at the end of the phase.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where /handoff writes <project>-handoff.md. ~ is your home folder.
